transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

No matter how interested I am, I can’t keep my attention on job training or applications long enough to finish them. I'm really trying to get my career in automotive repair going, but I just feel completely stuck because I can't seem to follow through on these things.
Have you also been feeling restless, fidgety, or easily distracted, even in situations that don't involve work or training?

Yes, absolutely, it happens everywhere. My legs are constantly bouncing, I'm always fidgeting with my keys, and even a tiny noise or text vibration completely throws me off focus. My family actually jokes that I can never just "chill" because I'm always pacing around the house or starting random hands-on projects.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt unusually sad, hopeless, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy, not just due to distraction or restlessness?

No, I haven't really had times where I felt deeply sad or lost interest in the things I love, like working on cars. I definitely feel frustrated and ashamed about my struggles with focus and keeping a job, but my actual passion for my hobbies is still there.
